name: John Bolton Super PAC

summary.text: The John Bolton Super PAC was a political committee led by John Bolton, later national security adviser. The Center for Public Integrity reported from FEC filings that it paid Cambridge Analytica more than $1.1 million from 2014 for research and survey research, and that Robert Mercer gave it $5 million from 2013 and was its largest donor in the 2016 cycle. The Campaign Legal Center filed an FEC complaint over the arrangement; it remains an allegation.
